notes.title: Croissant v1.1
notes.content:
[h3]Thanks for playing Croissant, lots of things are in the pipeline.[/h3] [b]Starting tomorrow, a first content update will add new skins and other little things.[/b]

[b]The first few hours of the game were rather complicated, but after several hours of correction the game is now functional (except for the change of ingame skins, which still works half-heartedly for some).[/b]
